author: TNN
description: A 35-year-old former software engineer, P Sushma, died by suicide in Bengaluru. Her father alleges dowry harassment and domestic fights by her husband, Puneet Kumar, and his mother. The couple married five years ago and has a four-year-old son. Police have arrested Puneet Kumar on charges of dowry death. Sushma's family claims they provided substantial dowry at the wedding.
title: Ex-techie dies by suicide after quarrel with mother-in-law in Bengaluru; kin alleges harassment

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Trump declared the campaign against Iran "about a 15" on a scale of 10, citing success in decimating Iranian leadership and missile capabilities. He reiterated the goal of preventing nuclear weapons, vowing to continue joint operations with Israel despite escalating regional conflict, rising oil prices, and domestic criticism.
title: Middle East crisis: Trump rates US war effort ‘15 out of 10’; vows to push on against Iran

author: TNN
description: Oil marketing companies are absorbing recent crude oil price spikes, creating a buffer against inflation and GDP impacts. Despite a 16.8% rise in Brent crude, a full pass-through to consumers is unlikely, with OMCs expected to manage the increase through their margins. This strategy helps cushion India's economy from geopolitical shocks affecting its heavy reliance on imported oil.
title: Middle East tensions: Oil companies may cushion impact of spike - report

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
description: Nepal's upcoming election sees a generational clash as Gen Z voters challenge traditional leadership. Despite facing constitutional crises and internal party dissent, veteran politician KP Sharma Oli, a former dissident who spent years in prison, remains a formidable force. He is now seeking re-election from his long-held constituency, facing a direct challenge from a younger contender.
title: Nepal votes today: Pitted against Balen, Oli faces litmus test of 50-year-old career

author: NAOMI CANTON
description: A 16th-century bronze statue of Saint Tirumankai Alvar, taken from a Tamil Nadu temple, is returning to India from the UK. Acquired by the Ashmolean Museum in 1967, its provenance became questionable after a 2019 discovery. Following an investigation and a formal claim by India, the museum has agreed to its repatriation, highlighting a commitment to ethical collections.
title: Oxford museum set to return 500-year-old bronze statue taken from Tamil Nadu temple

author: Agencies
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent indicated President Trump's plan to raise universal tariffs to 15% could happen this week. While a temporary 10% levy is in place, authorities aim to reinstate previous tariffs within five months. Bessent also downplayed oil market risks from Middle East tensions, citing ample global supply and US support measures.
title: Tariff may be hiked to 15% this week: Scott Bessent

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Amidst escalating Middle East tensions following US-Israeli strikes on Iran, the United States has ordered non-emergency staff and their families to leave consulates in Pakistan's Karachi and Lahore. Similar directives were issued for Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Cyprus, with American citizens advised to reconsider travel to these nations due to rising safety risks and disrupted flights.
title: US orders non-emergency consular staff to leave Pakistan amid Middle East tensions

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A diplomatic dispute has erupted between the US and Spain after the White House claimed Madrid agreed to cooperate with military operations against Iran. Spain's foreign minister categorically denied this, stating their position on base usage and the conflict remains unchanged. This follows Spain's earlier refusal to allow US forces to use its bases for strikes against Iran.

author: TNN
description: Airlines are intensifying evacuation efforts with special flights as Middle East air travel disruptions continue for the fourth day. Indian carriers planned 58 flights on Wednesday, with IndiGo and Air India increasing capacity on long-haul routes. Airports in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are handling limited repatriation flights, while services in Bahrain, Doha, and Kuwait remain suspended.
